caption: The drawing depicts a cross-shaped object with a metallic or gray border, featuring four fan-like, triangular segments radiating from each corner where the arms of the cross intersect its central axis. The interior sections of the cross are filled with a pattern of wavy lines in green, reddish-brown, and beige colors. At the top of the cross, there is a small loop, suggesting it could be hung or worn. The whole design is centered on a plain background, with a handwritten inscription at the bottom right that reads "MATEJ G. CHOPLIN-TAOS-N.M." The drawing employs shading to create a sense of dimensionality on the border and the fan-like segments.
title: Tin and Painted Glass Cross
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
